title: Playboy May 1987 Vanna White Wheel of Fortune Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, May 1987 - Vanna White Before Wheel of Fortune. Original $3.50 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Vanna - Before Wheel of Fortune; The Year in Movies; Cars '87: Top Pros Pick the Best!; A Special Report - Drugs: Where We Stand.

Back cover: Marlboro cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
